title: Etherpad
name: etherpad
description: Collaborative text editor where everyone types in the same document at once, with history, chat and plugins. This one runs on Postgres. Source: https://github.com/ether/etherpad

env.name: ETHERPAD_ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.label: Admin password (required)
env.description: For the admin panel at /admin, where you sign in as admin. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

env.name: ETHERPAD_DB_PASSWORD
env.label: Database password (required)
env.description: Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it the same when you redeploy, or Etherpad can't reach its database.

env.name: ETHERPAD_PORT
env.label: Host port for the web UI

note: Set both passwords before you deploy (openssl rand -hex 32 makes good ones), since the stack won't start without them. Then open http://<your-host>:9001 and start a pad. Anyone who can reach it can create and edit pads, so keep it off the open internet or put a login in front of it. The admin panel is at /admin, user admin. Pads are stored in Postgres, in the postgres-data volume. Docs: docs.etherpad.org
